description: Turn a quoteToken from ravn_quote into an execution payload. Returns one of three shapes (executionType): TRANSACTION (sign and broadcast yourself), SIGNATURE (sign, RAVN submits), or DEPOSIT (send the input asset to a given address). RAVN never takes custody of funds — you always sign or send from your own wallet. TRANSACTION and SIGNATURE may also include an `approval` — an ERC-20 approve() you must broadcast and wait to be MINED before the transaction/signature, or it fails (reverts on TRANSACTION; on SIGNATURE the order is accepted and silently never fills). Only present when the sold token needs it — omitted for native-coin sells and already-approved tokens.

apiKey.description: Your RAVN API key, if you have one — raises your rate limit

destinationAddress.description: Late-bound output recipient, honoured by venues that bind at execution time (Chainflip, Garden, Layerswap, Mayan, NEAR Intents, Rift, RAVN two-hop routes). Every other venue fixes the recipient when it prices: a DIFFERENT address here is rejected rather than silently ignored. Supply destinationAddress on ravn_quote instead, which every venue honours

refundAddress.description: Late-bound refund recipient if the swap fails, honoured by venues that read one at execution time (Chainflip, Garden, NEAR Intents, Rift). Every other venue, Mayan, Layerswap and RAVN two-hop routes included, fixes the refund address when it prices: one that differs from the refund the quote was priced with is rejected rather than silently ignored. A quote priced without one refunds where it was priced (normally userAddress) at these venues, so a refundAddress here other than userAddress is rejected too, when userAddress is a valid address on the input chain (selling native Bitcoin with no quoted refund, a venue that can execute uses this one). Supply refundAddress on ravn_quote instead

name: ravn_execute

approvalData.description: SIGNATURE only, 0x Gasless: a second EIP-712 payload some venues need signed for the approval itself

fee.description: When your key sets a fee on a route with none of its own: { amount, address, chainId, transaction? }, paid by the user to RAVN in the input token; deposit.amount (or the transaction) already leaves it out. On DEPOSIT (Rift, private swaps) and on EVM TRANSACTION (Eco, Layerswap, Mayan routes paying no referrer). EVM: send `transaction` exactly as given — on its own, or, for an ERC-20 fee, in the same wallet batch or relay as the swap (EIP-5792 / 7702 / 4337; one fee-bearing swap per batch). A native-coin deposit or fee is never batched: send each as a plain tx of its own from a regular wallet. Sent on its own, send the fee once the deposit or swap has confirmed: a fee paid on a swap the venue refunds stays with RAVN and nothing is owed on it. Then pass the on-chain hash of the tx that carried it (not a batch id or userOpHash) as txHash on every ravn_status poll — it counts once confirmed. Bitcoin (no `transaction`): pay `amount` sats to `address` as an extra output of the SAME transaction that pays the deposit — pass them to ravn_btc_prepare_send as feeAddress/feeAmountSats. Solana deposit (no `transaction`): add the fee to the SAME transaction that pays the deposit exactly deposit.amount — SOL: a System transfer of `amount` lamports to `address`; a token: createAssociatedTokenAccountIdempotent for `address` and the input mint (under the mint's token program), then transferChecked of `amount` to that associated token account; a fee in a transaction of its own isn't found. A Solana TRANSACTION RAVN builds has no `fee`: it's already inside transaction.serialized — send it from the signing wallet itself. Skip it and the swap still fills, but no fee is owed

quoteToken.description: Pass to ravn_submit_signature and ravn_status. On compose this is the post-bind token from execute, not the original quote token

statusRef.description: Poll ravn_status with this. Always set for DEPOSIT and SIGNATURE, and on a TRANSACTION whenever the venue tracks the swap by its own key (compose, Relay, Layerswap, Garden…); otherwise poll a TRANSACTION with the origin tx hash

submit.description: SIGNATURE only: { url, payload? } — POST the signed payload(s) to ravn_status's ref via /api/v1/submit-signature

transaction.description: TRANSACTION only. On Solana (chainId -2): `serialized`, a base64 versioned transaction — have the user's wallet sign it exactly as returned and send it within a minute; never modify it, it can carry RAVN's partial signatures

title: Execute a RAVN swap quote
